evidence.note: Title slide is clean: serif headline, small subline, soft blue blurred backdrop, consistent header chrome.
Large £612 figure with a small caption; the right two-thirds of the slide is empty, so the stat reads as isolated rather than placed.
A single small quote tile with tiny text sits mid-left under the title; the slide is otherwise blank and no visual shows the 26-of-33 survey result.
Three-box Install / 12 months measured / Go or stop flow with very small labels beside a three-bullet list; low in the slide with large empty space above.
Step-built Shared array -> Landlord supply -> Flats flow is consistent and uncluttered; step 4 blurs the diagram behind an Insight tile; boxes are generic and the diagram is simple.
Risk slide is three tiny bullets low on an otherwise empty slide, no visual.
Installer vs treasurer comparison is a small, plain two-column table with tiny text and wide empty space above.
Closing ask is a centred serif statement on the blurred backdrop, matching s-1 styling.
Header chrome, kicker labels, serif titles and sans body text are applied consistently across all slides; nothing collides.

rationale: Styling is consistent and nothing collides, so the deck is clean rather than unfinished or uneven. However most content slides are sparse (s-2, s-3, s-6 use small text in largely empty canvases) and the diagrams are generic box flows that do little beyond s-5, so it falls short of the considered reference. That fits level 3: consistent and clean, but generic, with diagrams not yet filling their purpose.
